description: Engine setup of map3_s00 (Hospital - until Kaufmann meeting), a map made only of data and Lua: "map_type" is the map type HP, the entry of gamedata/config/map_info.json that gives its zones, scenery file and environment. "characters" lists the character types this map runs, each by its gamedata/chara/<Name>/behavior.lua; a character type that is not listed cannot act here (this map: Kaufmann and EndingKaufmann). A mod changes it with its own maps/map3_s00/overlay.json.
